description: Réseau de transport urbains Dignois is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PROVENCE-ALPES-AGGLOMERATION. Provence Alpes Agglomération organizes, on a day-to-day basis, the Transports Urbains Dignois (TUD). This network serving the City of Digne-les-Bains consists of 4 urban lines (including a doubled line for schools) operating from Monday to Saturday, as well as an on-demand transport service for people with reduced mobility: FlexiTUD. Coverage: PROVENCE-ALPES-AGGLOMERATION. The portal shows the English title as "Dignois Urban Transport Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is PROVENCE-ALPES-AGGLOMERATION. Its keywords include digne-les-bains, bus, transport, mobilite, gtfs. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
